preconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(x) <= k or -k <= int(x) <= -1 for x in s.split())
preconditions.description: Every element in the initial string s is an integer t where 1 ≤ |t| ≤ k.
The length of the string n and the number of bracket types k satisfy 1 ≤ n, k ≤ 10^5 and k ≤ n.
The number of queries q satisfies 1 ≤ q ≤ 10^5.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= i <= n and 1 <= abs(int(t)) <= k for query in queries if query[0] == 1 and (i, t) == query[1:])
preconditions.description: For type-1 queries, the position i is within bounds (1 ≤ i ≤ n) and the bracket t satisfies 1 ≤ |t| ≤ k.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= l <= r <= n for query in queries if query[0] == 2 and (l, r) == query[1:])
preconditions.description: For type-2 queries, the substring bounds l and r satisfy 1 ≤ l ≤ r ≤ n.

postconditions.expression: all(stdout_line == 'Yes' if is_correct_bracket_sequence(s, l, r) else stdout_line == 'No' for (query_type, l, r) in queries if query_type == 2 for stdout_line in output_lines)
postconditions.description: For each type-2 query (l, r), the output line is 'Yes' if the substring s[l..r] (1-based) is a correct bracket sequence, otherwise 'No'.

postconditions.expression: all(s[i-1] == t for (query_type, i, t) in queries if query_type == 1)
postconditions.description: After processing all queries, the string s is updated such that for each type-1 query (i, t), the bracket at position i (1-based) is replaced by t.

invariants.expression: all(1 <= abs(int(x)) <= k for x in s.split())
invariants.description: At all times, every element in the string s is an integer t where 1 ≤ |t| ≤ k.
